name: Exp_ATR_Trailing
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies the stop-loss of existing open positions based on the ATR_Trailing custom indicator. It does not open new positions itself; it only trails stop-losses for already-open buy or sell positions. The trailing logic tightens stops as price moves in favor, locking in profits according to ATR-based levels.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个追踪止损工具，基于ATR_Trailing自定义指标修改已有持仓的止损价位。它本身不开仓，仅对已存在的多头或空头持仓进行止损追踪调整，根据ATR水平在价格有利方向移动时收紧止损以锁定利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是利用ATR（平均真实波幅）指标动态调整已有持仓的止损位，实现追踪止损功能。入场条件方面，EA本身不执行任何开仓操作，仅管理已有仓位。出场条件通过追踪止损实现：对于多头仓位，使用指标下轨线作为止损参考，止损只上移不下移；对于空头仓位，使用指标上轨线作为止损参考，止损只下移不上移。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及开仓手数设置，仅修改现有仓位的止损和止盈。资金管理方面，EA没有独立的资金管理逻辑，完全依赖用户自行开仓后的仓位大小。当持仓没有止损时，EA会在新bar出现时根据指标值设置初始止损；当已有止损时，仅在指标给出更优止损值时才修改。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept uses the ATR (Average True Range) indicator to dynamically adjust stop-loss levels for existing positions, implementing a trailing stop mechanism. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not execute any opening trades itself; it only manages already-opened positions. Exit conditions are implemented via trailing stops: for long positions, the indicator's lower band serves as the stop reference, with the stop only moving upward never downward; for short positions, the indicator's upper band is used, with the stop only moving downward never upward. For position sizing, the EA does not handle lot size calculation since it only modifies existing position stops and take-profits. Money management is entirely absent from the EA logic, relying completely on the user's initial position size when they opened the trade. When a position has no stop-loss, the EA sets an initial stop based on the indicator values on a new bar; when a stop already exists, it only modifies it when the indicator provides a more favorable stop level.

parameters.description_en: ATR stop-loss multiplier for long positions

pros: 基于ATR的追踪止损能自适应市场波动率，波动大时止损宽，波动小时止损窄
止损只朝有利方向移动（多头只上移、空头只下移），有效锁定浮盈
使用新bar检测机制避免频繁修改，减少交易请求和网络负载
代码结构清晰，买卖方向修改逻辑分离，易于理解和维护
pros_en: ATR-based trailing stops adapt to market volatility automatically — wider stops in volatile markets, tighter in calm markets
Stops only move in the favorable direction (up for longs, down for shorts), effectively locking in unrealized profits
New bar detection mechanism prevents excessive modification requests, reducing trade server load and network traffic
Clean code structure with buy and sell modification logic separated into distinct functions for readability and maintainability
cons: EA本身不开仓，用户需手动或配合其他EA开仓，使用不够便捷
使用ORDER_FILLING_FOK填充模式，部分券商不支持该模式可能导致修改失败
空头修改函数中使用Ask价格而非Bid价格作为参考，存在逻辑不合理之处
缺少Magic Number过滤，会修改同品种所有仓位而非仅特定策略的仓位
StopCorrect函数当SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL为0时返回false，某些券商该值为0时会导致功能失效
cons_en: The EA does not open positions itself, requiring manual entry or pairing with another EA, which is inconvenient
Uses ORDER_FILLING_FOK fill mode which some brokers do not support, potentially causing modification failures
The sell position modify function uses Ask price instead of Bid as reference, which is logically inconsistent for short positions
No Magic Number filtering means it modifies all positions on the symbol regardless of which strategy opened them
StopCorrect function returns false when SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL is 0, breaking functionality on brokers where this value is zero
improvements: 增加Magic Number过滤参数，仅管理特定策略的仓位，避免误修改其他EA的持仓
修复StopCorrect函数中SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL为0时的处理逻辑，改为返回true或使用SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL替代方案
空头修改函数应使用Bid价格而非Ask价格作为止损计算基准
添加ORDER_FILLING类型自动检测或选择功能，兼容更多券商
增加追踪止损的可视化显示功能，在图表上绘制当前止损线
improvements_en: Add a Magic Number filter parameter to manage only specific strategy positions and avoid accidentally modifying other EAs' positions
Fix StopCorrect function logic when SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL is 0 — should return true or use an alternative minimum stops level
The sell position modify function should use Bid price instead of Ask as the basis for stop-loss calculation
Add automatic detection or selection of ORDER_FILLING type for better broker compatibility
Add visual display of the current trailing stop level by drawing stop lines on the chart

risk_points: 该EA仅为止损追踪工具，不主动开仓，不会产生新的风险敞口
缺少Magic Number过滤可能导致意外修改其他策略的止损
ORDER_FILLING_FOK硬编码可能在部分券商导致修改失败但不会造成资金损失
risk_points_en: This EA is only a trailing stop tool that does not open positions, creating no new risk exposure
Lack of Magic Number filtering could lead to accidental modification of other strategies' stops
Hardcoded ORDER_FILLING_FOK may cause modification failures on some brokers but will not cause financial loss
